title: Book of Job as a deliberate Mithraic-Kabbalistic text tied to the Achaemenid Magi's restoration of Israel

tellings.quote: And look, now I make a complicated argument for that. In Iranian Leviathan, you have to look at like in the Acemened Persian Empire, who were the Mithraic Magi who were involved with the project of recreating Israel, the first Zionist project in history.

plain: A researcher and author named Jason Jorjani argues in his book Iranian Leviathan that the Book of Job in the Bible was written on purpose as a text mixing Mithraic ideas, from the worship of the Persian god Mithra, with Kabbalistic ones, from Jewish mysticism. He says it ties back to the Magi, Persian priests in the ancient Achaemenid Persian Empire, who he says were involved in rebuilding Israel, which he calls the first Zionist project in history. If so, a famous biblical book would carry a hidden Persian design.
